ruleset.name: AppExchange_html
ruleset.description: AppExchange Security Rules for Visualforce Language

rule.name: AvoidCreateElementScriptLinkTag
rule.message: Load JavaScript/CSS only from static resources.
rule.description: Detects dynamic creation of script or link tags Note: This rule identifies the `<script>` block where `createElement` is detected; but can only show the line number where the `<script>` tag begins and not the line number for `createElement`. That means if there are multiple `createElement` calls with `script` as input, you'll see multiple issues reported with the line number of the `<script>` tag. This is a known issue; developers are expected to go through the `<script>` block to identify the use of `createElement`
rule.example: <script src="{!$Resource.jquery}"/> See more examples on properly using static resources here: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.secure_coding_guide.meta/secure_coding_guide/secure_coding_cross_site_scripting.htm

rule.name: AvoidHardcodedSecretsInVFAttrs
rule.message: Hardcoded secrets detected in VF attributes
rule.description: Detects hardcoded secrets in VF attributes

rule.name: AvoidUnauthorizedApiSessionIdInVisualforce
rule.message: Retrieval of session ID using API.Session_ID is not authorized.
rule.description: Detects use of Api.Session_ID to retrieve a session ID in Visualforce code. For more guidance on approved use cases, read the [Session Id Guidance](https://partners.salesforce.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/0684V00000O83jT?asPdf=false) document.

rule.name: AvoidUnauthorizedGetSessionIdInVisualforce
rule.message: Use of session ID with GETSESSIONID is not authorized.
rule.description: Detects use of GETSESSIONID() to retrieve a session ID in Visualforce code. For more guidance on approved use cases, read the [Session Id Guidance](https://partners.salesforce.com/sfc/servlet.shepherd/version/download/0684V00000O83jT?asPdf=false) document.

rule.name: LoadCSSApexStylesheet
rule.message: Load JavaScript only from static resources.
rule.description: Determines where CSS must be loaded as a static resource
rule.example: <apex:stylesheet value="{!$Resource.mycssresource}"/> See more examples on properly using static resources here: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.secure_coding_guide.meta/secure_coding_guide/secure_coding_cross_site_scripting.htm

rule.name: LoadCSSLinkHref
rule.message: Load JavaScript only from static resources.
rule.description: Determines where CSS must be loaded as a static resource
rule.example: <link rel="stylesheet" src="{!$Resource.mycustomcss}"/> See more examples on properly using static resources here: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.secure_coding_guide.meta/secure_coding_guide/secure_coding_cross_site_scripting.htm

rule.name: LoadJavaScriptHtmlScript
rule.message: Load JavaScript only from static resources.
rule.description: Determines HTML script locations where JavaScript code must be loaded as static resources.
rule.example: <script src="{!$Resource.jquery}"/> See more examples on properly using static resources here: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.secure_coding_guide.meta/secure_coding_guide/secure_coding_cross_site_scripting.htm

rule.name: LoadJavaScriptIncludeScript
rule.message: Load JavaScript only from static resources.
rule.description: Determines include script locations where JavaScript code must be loaded as static resources.
rule.example: <apex:IncludeScript value="{!$Resource.jquery}"/> See more examples on properly using static resources here: https://developer.salesforce.com/docs/atlas.en-us.secure_coding_guide.meta/secure_coding_guide/secure_coding_cross_site_scripting.htm
